decisions.what: Overwrote existing .gitignore with full HTML/CSS/JS-appropriate ignore rules
decisions.why: The existing .gitignore only had 'arvad_task_files/' entry; spec required comprehensive OS, IDE, node_modules, build, env, log, and temp file exclusions

decisions.what: Overwrote existing README.md with comprehensive project documentation
decisions.why: The existing README.md was a stub; spec required full documentation including tech stack table, features list, setup instructions, project structure, deployment guide, design principles, and contributing guidelines

decisions.what: Created LICENSE with MIT License text using year 2026
decisions.why: Spec requested standard MIT License; used current year (2026) as specified and a descriptive copyright holder name matching the project

decisions.what: Applied dark luxury color palette (#0a0a0a background, #c9a96e gold accent)
decisions.why: Spec calls for a Luxury Gen-Z fashion brand; dark premium aesthetic aligns with photography_centric and minimalist_typography design patterns from 000_landing_page_design_rules.md

decisions.what: Used Tailwind CDN v3.x with inline tailwind.config for custom tokens
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires Tailwind CSS CDN v3.x from cdn.tailwindcss.com; custom config allows brand colors and keyframes without a build step

decisions.what: Implemented scroll-triggered reveals via Intersection Observer
decisions.why: scroll_triggered_reveals is a selected design pattern; Intersection Observer is a native, zero-dependency approach consistent with the plain HTML/CSS/JS project structure

decisions.what: Added skeleton loading CSS animation on gallery/product card placeholders
decisions.why: skeleton_loading is a selected design pattern; improves perceived performance for image-heavy sections on mobile connections

decisions.what: Implemented morphing button interactions with CSS ::after overlay and letter-spacing expansion
decisions.why: morphing_button_interactions is a selected design pattern; achieves premium feel without JS overhead

decisions.what: Added social proof section with blockquote testimonials and press logo strip
decisions.why: social_proof_heavy is a selected design pattern; positioned near CTA as recommended in implementation guidance

decisions.what: Included skip link, aria-label attributes, aria-expanded on hamburger, and sr-only figcaptions
decisions.why: Tier 2 task (landing page) requires ARIA labels on interactive elements and keyboard accessibility per HTML code generation rules

decisions.what: Added prefers-reduced-motion guard for all animations
decisions.why: HTML code generation rules and design pattern rules both require respecting reduced motion preference; critical for accessibility
